commands.executed_command_with_normalized_root:
python - <<'PY'
import json,zipfile,collections,datetime,time
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('<PRIOR_AHAS_ROOT>')
for rel in ('ahas-realworld-review/inputs/Cornell.corpus.zip','ahas-pilot2-20260914/data/ApplyingToCollege.corpus.zip','ahas-pilot2-20260914/data/college.corpus.zip'):
 p=r/rel;c=collections.Counter();min_ts=None;max_ts=None
 with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
  with z.open('utterances.jsonl') as f:
   for line in f:
    row=json.loads(line);c['source_rows']+=1
    c['submissions' if row.get('id')==row.get('root') else 'comments']+=1
    t=row.get('timestamp')
    if isinstance(t,int): min_ts=t if min_ts is None else min(min_ts,t);max_ts=t if max_ts is None else max(max_ts,t)
    for key in ('id','user','root','timestamp'):
     if row.get(key) in (None,''):c['missing_'+key]+=1
    if row.get('id')!=row.get('root') and row.get('reply_to') in (None,''):c['comments_missing_reply_to']+=1
 print(json.dumps({'archive':p.name,'fresh_metadata_counts':dict(c),'first_utc':datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(min_ts,datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'last_utc':datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(max_ts,datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'no_text_or_style_inspection':True},sort_keys=True))
